$comment: The team console (apps/clinic). Permissions are per app: object sched_app:<psizone|hemisync> (one console, several closed worlds). This manifest declares only the app-level types and relations; the GRANULAR permissions (resource x action x scope x field group, docs/plans/clinic.md section 4) are roles-as-data in the scheduling service, which writes the tuples. The console asks Check(user:<sub>, member, sched_app:<app>) and ListObjects(sched_app, member); it stores no role.
